Runemaster.name: Runemaster
stats: 10% increased Cast Speed with Elemental Spells

Sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
stats: Spells deal increased damage equal to their mana cost

Spellblade.name: Spellblade
stats: Mana spent on melee attacks is converted to ward

Mage-63.name: Lavamancer
reminderText: Penetration can bring enemies below 0% resistance, causing them to take more damage. It applies to all damage, including damage over time.

Mage-66.name: Whirling Snow
stats: 7% Chance To Chill Attackers When Hit
description: You have a chance to chill enemies when you are hit, and your skills have a chance to chill enemies on hit. This effect is doubled for cold skills.

Mage-11.name: Essence of Celerity
description: Each stack of {Arcane Momentum} lasts longer and also increases your spell damage.

Mage-64.name: Distant Spark
description: When you critically strike an enemy from at least 4 meters away, you have a chance to cast {Spark Nova,} a spell that deals lightning damage to nearby enemies.
reminderText: {Spark Nova} critical strikes cannot result in more Spark Novas.

Mage-76.name: Elixir of Knowledge
stats: 1 Ward on Potion Use per Intelligence
description: Whenever you use a potion, you gain ward based on your intelligence.

Mage-62.name: Chill to the Bone
reminderText: Penetration can bring enemies below 0% resistance, causing them to take more damage. It applies to all damage, including damage over time.

Mage-27.name: Mana Bulwark
stats: 2% Damage Dealt to Mana Before Health
description: You have additional mana and a portion of the damage you take is dealt to your mana before health.

Mage-61.name: Rift Bolt
reminderText: Penetration can bring enemies below 0% resistance, causing them to take more damage. It applies to all damage, including damage over time.

Mage-20.name: Calculated Destruction
notScalingStats: 3% Increased Spell Critical Strike Chance per Intelligence
reminderText: Each point of intelligence grants 4% ward retention and improves skills that rely on carefully studied magic, such as Lightning Blast and Mana Strike.

Mage-22.name: Crackling Precision
description: You have an increased chance to critically strike with spells. This effect is doubled for lightning skills.

Mage-13.name: Arcane Momentum
description:
When you cast a spell you gain a stack of {Arcane Momentum} for 2 seconds and refreshing the duration of all existing stacks.

Each stacks of Arcane Momentum increases your cast speed.
reminderText: You can only have one instance of Arcane Momentum.

Mage-28.name: Warder
description:
You have a chance to be granted ward whenever you hit an enemy with a fire, cold, or lightning skill.

This effect has a 10 second cooldown, but the cooldown is not shared between different elements, so you can gain ward from a fire hit and a lightning hit within the same 10 second duration.

Mage-60.name: Afterglow
description: You deal increased spell damage and have additional ward retention.
reminderText: The doubled increased spell damage also applies to the skill that triggers it.

Mage-15.name: Lost Knowledge
description: You gain ward based on your current mana when you directly use a skill that costs at least 40 mana.
reminderText: Ward is a decaying shield that protects your health

Mage-25.name: Chronomancy
reminderText: Each point of vitality grants 6 health and 1% poison and necrotic resistance.

Mage-14.name: Wisdom
notScalingStats: 5% Increased Mana Regen per 100 Max Mana
reminderText: This does not require exact thresholds of 100 mana. For example, gaining 10 maximum mana will always grant 0.3% increased mana regen.

Mage-12.name: Mana Shell
notScalingStats: +1 Ward Per Second Per 10 Max Mana

Mage-29.name: Arcane Current
notScalingStats: +100% Spark Charge Chance With Static Orb
description: You deal more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

Mage-30.name: Archmage
stats: 7% Chance To Refund 20% Of Mana Cost
description:
You have additional spell damage and you have a chance to refund a portion of the mana cost paid when directly using a skill.

These values are doubled if you have 300 maximum mana and tripled if you have 1000 maximum mana.

Mage-69.name: Arcane Insight
description: You have additional Intelligence and you gain additional ward decay threshold scaling with your Intelligence.

Mage-67.name: Elemental Ascendance
stats: 8% Increased Stun Chance With Elemental Spells

gl14-15.name: Cold Snap
description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Glacier costs more mana.

gl14-5.name: Greater Destruction
description: Glacier’s largest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

gl14-10.name: Moderate Vortex
description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion has a greater chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, and the {Rime} buff has increased duration.
reminderText: {Ice Vortex} scales with increased to cold damage, damage over time, and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

gl14-9.name: Lesser Vortex
description: Glacier’s smallest explosion has a chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, which lasts for 4 seconds and deals spell cold damage over time.
reminderText: {Ice Vortex} scales with increased to cold damage, damage over time, and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

gl14-7.name: Moderate Chilling
description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to chill enemies.

gl14-8.name: Greater Chilling
description: Glacier’s largest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to chill enemies.

gl14-25.name: Engulfing Vortex
description: {Ice Vortices} created by Glacier have a chance to instead become a {Greater Ice Vortex} that deals significantly more damage and has a larger radius.

gl14-18.name: Cold Victory
stats: 1% Percent Of Maximum Mana Gained On Kill
description: Glacier kills grant mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana.

gl14-19.name: Fading Echoes
description: Glacier’s explosions occur in reverse order.

gl14-21.name: Static Collapse
notScalingStats: Crits No Longer Deal Extra Damage
description: All of Glacier’s explosions occur at a target location, but Glacier's critical hits no longer deal extra damage (compared to non-critical hits).

gl14-27.name: Endless Frost
description: Chill chance granted by this tree is doubled. Glacier hits deal more damage to chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

gl14-20.name: Resplendent Frost
description: Greatly improves Glacier’s base critical strike chance, but reduces its critical strike multiplier.

gl14-14.name: Lesser Glacier
description: Glacier costs less mana, but the largest explosion is disabled.

gl14-30.name: Snow Blink
stats: Does not use the Teleport Skill or Tree
description:
When you directly cast Glacier you are teleported to the target location, as long as the location is accessible. This does not count as casting the Teleport skill and is not affected by Teleport's skill tree.

Glacier also gains a cooldown and now counts as a {Traversal} skill.
reminderText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

gl14-13.name: Rime Caster
description: When you cast Glacier you gain the {Rime} buff which increases your damage over time and freeze rate multiplier.
reminderText:
Rime does not stack.

The Rime buff does affect the Glacier cast that grants it.

gl14-22.name: Perma Frost
description: Glacier has a higher chance to freeze enemies, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

gl14-11.name: Greater Vortex
description: Glacier’s largest explosion has a greater chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, and the {Rime} buff has increased effect.
reminderText: {Ice Vortex} scales with increased to cold damage, damage over time, and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

gl14-17.name: Critical Rejuvenation
description: Critical hits with Glacier grant mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, up to a limited number of times per second.

gl14-2.name: Chilling Force
description: Each of Glacier’s explosions has a chance to chill enemies.

gl14-26.name: Morditas' Bane
stats: +25% Hit Damage Against Rares And Bosses
description: Glacier deals more hit damage to rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

gl14-3.name: Lesser Destruction
description: Glacier’s smallest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

gl14-4.name: Moderate Destruction
description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

gl14-6.name: Lesser Chilling
description: Glacier’s smallest explosion has a chance to chill enemies.

gl14-28.name: Critical Barrier
description: You gain ward on critical strikes with Glacier.

gl14-12.name: Whirlpools
description: Each of Glacier’s explosions has a chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, which lasts for 4 seconds and deals spell cold damage over time.
reminderText: {Ice Vortex} scales with increased to cold damage, damage over time, and spell damage, but not with other nodes on this tree.

gl14-24.name: Breaking Point
description: Glacier costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

gl14-16.name: Frost Grip
description: Glacier has an increased chance to freeze and stun enemies.

rn7iv-23.name: Adept Runescribing
description: Runic Invocation has a shorter cooldown.

rn7iv-16.name: Copied Scrolls
description: Runic Invocation now has a chance to be repeated per stack of {Runic Energy}.

rn7iv-30.name: Elemental Starfield
stats: Cast Elemental Novas From Runes In Invocation
description:
Whenever you cast Runic Invocation, you also cast up to one of each type of {Elemental Nova} that you can cast directly. Each unique {Rune} you have when casting Runic Invocation represents different {Elemental Nova}. 

These {Novas} are cast with a 0.3 second interval.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Elemental Nova's} mana cost.
reminderText:
{Rah Rune}: Fire Nova
{Gon Rune}: Lightning Nova
{Heo Rune}: Ice Nova

If you don't have any of the three Elemental Nova types unlocked, then you'll cast one Elemental Nova if you have at least one rune.

rn7iv-28.name: Devastating Starfall
description: Runic Invocation deals more damage per type of {Rune} consumed.

rn7iv-26.name: Transcriber of Power
description:
After casting Runic Invocation you gain additional spell damage and cast speed for a short duration. 

The buff duration scales with amount of {Runes} consumed.

rn7iv-15.name: Spell Cascade
stats: Cast Random Equipped Skill With 12 Energy
description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation with at least 12 {Runic Energy} you also proc a random equipped non-channeling skill of the same element as each of the {Runes} consumed.

This effect consumes these skills' mana costs and puts them on cooldown (excluding movement skills and skills that are currently on cooldown).

These skills are cast at 0.24 second intervals after the {Invocation}.

rn7iv-29.name: Cosmic Mind
stats: 3 Ward Gain Per Intelligence With Different Runes
description: When you cast an {Invocation} using a sequence of three different {Runes} you gain ward per point of intelligence.

rn7iv-22.name: Immutable Order
stats: Rune Gain Depend On Skills On Action Bar
description:
Whenever you gain a {Rune}, instead of it depending on the type of skill cast, it always results in your sequence of {Runes} mirroring the first three skills on your action bar from left to right.

This effect ignores skills that don't have an elemental tag.
reminderText:
If a skill has multiple elements, the {Rune} it provides is chosen based on the least common elements among all 3 skills. 

For example casting {Disintegrate, Lightning Blast, Static Orb} in a sequence gives {Rah, Gon and Gon Runes}.

This effect ignores Runic Invocation itself when looking at the abilities on your bar.

rn7iv-7.name: Attuned Approach
description: Runic Invocation grants ward per {Rune} consumed and on direct casts you refund a portion of its mana cost.

rn7iv-27.name: Word of Lagon
stats: +3% Critical Strike Chance With Gon Rune
description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Gon Rune} have a chance to shock enemies and have a higher chance to critically hit enemies.

rn7iv-5.name: Interlude
description:
During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first two {Runes}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least two runes for this effect to occur.

rn7iv-4.name: Warmage's Initiative
description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation now leap forwards instead of backwards. 

The effect of {Enigma} no longer works when taking this node.

Runic Invocation gains the {Movement} tag.

rn7iv-14.name: Runic Energy
notScalingStats: +2% Damage Per Stack Of Runic Energy
description: Every second you go without casting a Runic Invocation you gain a stack of {Runic Energy} up to a maximum. {Invocations} consume all {Runic Energy} to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Runic Energy}.

rn7iv-24.name: Consolidator
stats: 6% Cooldown Reduction When Rune Combination Changes
description: While you have 3 {Runes} and your combination of {Runes} changes without casting an {Invocation}, Runic Invocation's remaining cooldown is reduced.
reminderText:
A {Rune} combination only considers the number and type of runes, and not the order.
For example, Rah-Rah-Heo is the same combination as Heo-Rah-Rah

rn7iv-3.name: Stride to Safety
description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation you leap backwards a short distance. In this state you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

Directly cast Runic Invocations deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

The effect of {Enigma} no longer works when taking this node.

Runic Invocation gains the {Movement} tag.

rn7iv-11.name: Glyphcarver's Dominance
description: {Invocations} that deal damage in an area now deal damage in a larger area.

rn7iv-32.name: Scrivener's Haste
description:
You gain {Runes} faster while channelling.

You gain a burst of ward based on your maximum mana when your number of runes increases from channelling.

rn7iv-21.name: Author of Arcana
description: Directly casting Runic Invocation now refunds its mana cost and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it now has a cooldown when cast this way.
reminderText: You cannot refund more than 100% of Runic Invocation's mana cost.

rn7iv-9.name: Elementalist's Call
description: When you directly cast Runic Invocation, the next non-channelled elemental spell you cast penetrates enemy elemental resistance and deals damage in a larger area.

rn7iv-12.name: Word of Rahyeh
stats: +6 Spell Fire Damage With Rah Rune
description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Rah Rune} have a chance to ignite enemies and deal additional spell fire damage.

rn7iv-6.name: Prologue
description:
During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first {Rune}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least one rune for this effect to occur.

rn7iv-17.name: Rune Powercore
stats: +1 Gain Runic Energy While At 3 Runes
description: While you have 3 runes and your combination of runes changes without casting an invocation, you gain {Runic Energy}.
reminderText:
A {Rune} combination only considers the number and type of runes, and not the order.
For example, Rah-Rah-Heo is the same combination as Heo-Rah-Rah

rn7iv-2.name: Unbridled Ruin
description: Runic Invocation deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Rune} consumed.

rn7iv-20.name: Word of Heorot
stats: +60% Freeze Rate Multiplier With Heo Rune
description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Heo Rune} have a chance to chill enemies and have a higher chance to freeze them.

rn7iv-34.name: Elemental Lore
description: Runic Invocation penetrates elemental resistances per point of Intelligence.

rn7iv-18.name: Arcane Battery
description: Your maximum {Runic Energy} is tripled, but bonuses per {Runic Energy} are halved. When you cast a skill you gain {Runic Energy} per mana spent.

rn7iv-19.name: Runic Energizer
stats: Accumulation Speed Resets On Repeat Invocation
description: Each unique {Invocation} you directly cast causes {Runic Energy} to accumulate faster until you repeat an {Invocation}.

rn7iv-13.name: Inscribed Patterns
stats: 2% Increased Mana Regen per Rah Rune
+4 Ward Gain Per Second per Gon Rune
+8% Freeze Rate Multiplier per Heo Rune
description:
Runes now provide you with passive effects while you have them.

{Rah Rune}: Grants increased mana regeneration per {Rune} of this type.
{Gon Rune}: Grants ward per second per {Rune} of this type.
{Heo Rune}: Grants a higher chance to freeze enemies per {Rune} of this type.

rn7iv-25.name: Enigma
description:
Whenever you directly cast an {Invocation} you blink to the target location first, but Runic Invocation now has a cooldown. 

{Invocations} cast this way automatically targets a random nearby enemy.

Runic Invocation gains the {Traversal} tag.
reminderText: All the effects of this node do not affect Runic Invocation if you have taken the {Stride to Safety} node.

rn7iv-8.name: Rune Slinger
description: Runic Invocation has increased cast speed and when directly casting an {Invocation} you gain ward equal to a portion of your current mana.

rn7iv-10.name: Mastery of the Invoker
stats: 6% Invocations Chance On Other Skill Use
description: When you consume {Runes} with a skill other than Runic Invocation you have a chance to also cast the corresponding {Invocation} for those runes.

sb44eQ-21.name: Icicle Strike
description:
{Passive:} Your melee attacks have a chance to cast piercing {Ice Shards} towards enemies they hit, up to a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

{Active:} The chance to cast Ice Shards is tripled.
reminderText:
{Icicles} deal cold damage on hit and scale with spell damage and cold damage, but not other nodes on this tree.

Activating Enchant Weapon also resets this cooldown.

sb44eQ-25.name: Cleansed by the Elements
description: Activating Enchant Weapon cleanses negative ailments.

sb44eQ-13.name: Flameblast
description:
{Passive:} {Fire Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

{Active:} Fire Burst also has increased area of effect.
reminderText: {Fire Burst} deals fire damage on hit and scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage but not other nodes on this tree, unless stated otherwise.

sb44eQ-1.name: Celerity
description: {Active:} You have increased melee attack speed.

sb44eQ-19.name: Frozen Sparks
stats: +1 Melee Lightning Damage Per 5 Melee Damage
+1 Melee Cold Damage Per 5 Melee Damage
description: {Active:} You deal additional cold and lightning damage with melee attacks based on your weapon's melee damage.
reminderText: If you have 19 added damage on your weapon, you will receive +3 cold and +3 lightning melee damage. If you have less than 5 added damage on your weapon, this node does nothing.

sb44eQ-11.name: Searing Conflagration
description: Ignites consumed by {Conflagrate} deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

sb44eQ-5.name: Capacitance
description: {Zap} from {Conduit} has a chance to be replaced with {Lightning Blast}.

sb44eQ-9.name: Eternal Flames
description: {Passive:} Ignites you inflict last longer (doubled while active).

sb44eQ-10.name: Conflagrate
description: Activating Enchant Weapon consumes all ignite stacks on nearby enemies, causing their damage to be dealt instantly.

sb44eQ-17.name: Kindling Blade
description: When you directly use a melee attack, Enchant Weapon will automatically activate if it is not on cooldown.
reminderText: Enchant Weapon will activate before the melee attack.

sb44eQ-24.name: Overloaded
description: Activating Enchant Weapon causes your next melee elemental attack to be free.

sb44eQ-14.name: Concentration
description: Enchant Weapon is active for longer.

sb44eQ-2.name: Fulminate
description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to shock enemies with melee attacks.

{Active:} This effect is doubled.

sb44eQ-8.name: Immolating Strike
description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to ignite enemies with melee attacks.

{Active:} This effect is doubled.

sb44eQ-16.name: Efficacy
description:
{Passive:} Activating Enchant Weapon costs less mana.

{Active:} You deal increased elemental damage with melee attacks.

sb44eQ-12.name: Burst of Fire
description:
{Passive:} Cast {Fire Burst} when hitting an ignited enemy, up to a limited number of times per 2 seconds.

{Active:} Fire Burst's limit is doubled.
reminderText:
{Fire Burst} deals fire damage on hit and scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage but not other nodes on this tree, unless stated otherwise.

Activating Enchant Weapon also resets this cooldown.

sb44eQ-4.name: Conduit
stats: 25% Chance to Zap on Melee Hit
description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to cast {Zap} when you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.

{Active:} Zap's cooldown is reduced.
reminderText:
{Zap} scales with spell damage and lightning damage, but not other nodes on this skill tree.

Activating Enchant Weapon also resets this cooldown.

sb44eQ-6.name: Draw Power
description: {Active:} You leech a portion of the fire and lightning damage you deal with melee attacks as health.

sb44eQ-23.name: Frostbrand
description: {Active:} You deal additional cold damage with melee attacks, and deal increased cold damage with melee attacks.

sb44eQ-3.name: Thundering
description: {Active:} You deal additional lightning damage with melee attacks, and deal increased lightning damage with melee attacks.

sb44eQ-20.name: Shivering Blade
stats: +20% Percent of Chill Chance gained as Frostbite Chance
description:
{Passive:} You have a chance to chill enemies with melee attacks, and you gain a chance to inflict frostbite on enemies based on your chill chance.

{Active:} Both of these effects are doubled.

sb44eQ-7.name: Molten Steel
description: {Active:} You deal additional fire damage with melee attacks, and deal increased fire damage with melee attacks.

sb44eQ-18.name: Power Vent
description: {Active:} You gain stacks of {Fire Aura} every second.

sb44eQ-26.name: Unstable Enchantment
stats: Casts Elemental Nova on Active Start and End
description:
Enchant Weapon has a reduced cooldown and duration.

{Active:} You cast {Elemental Nova} when you activate Enchant Weapon and when its active duration ends, consuming mana equal to Elemental Nova's mana cost.

sb44eQ-15.name: Desperation
stats: 1% Melee Elemental Damage Per 2% Missing Mana
description: {Active:} You deal increased elemental damage with melee attacks proportional to how much mana you are missing when Enchant Weapon is activated.

sb44eQ-22.name: To The Bone
description: {Active:} {Ice Shards} fires 2 additional projectiles.
reminderText: {Icicles} deal cold damage on hit and scale with spell damage and cold damage, but not other nodes of this tree.

bh2-23.name: Supermassive
description: Black Hole deals more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it prioritises moving towards rare enemies and bosses.

bh2-10.name: Umbral Core
description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

bh2-2.name: Tidal Force
description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Black Hole pulls enemies towards it slower.

bh2-21.name: Spacial Dilation
description: Black Hole moves faster toward the nearest enemy.

bh2-14.name: Deep Space
description: The explosions created by the {Collapse} and {Pulsar} nodes have an increased chance to freeze enemies.

bh2-4.name: Red Giant
description:
Black Hole’s base cold damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Black Hole lasts much longer, but no longer pulls enemies.

bh2-25.name: Endless Maw
description: Black Hole has increased duration, but has additional cooldown duration.

bh2-12.name: Collapse
description: Black Hole will {Collapse} at the end of its duration, an explosion which deals cold hit damage and knocks enemies back.

bh2-8.name: Infusion
description: Black Hole grants you ward each second.

bh2-26.name: Scattered
description: A second Black Hole is created 10 meters away in a random direction from the first Black Hole.

bh2-22.name: Gravity's Guile
description: Black Hole’s center hits enemies, dealing spell physical damage.

bh2-9.name: Binary System
description:
Black Hole becomes two stars which orbit each other. One deals fire damage and the other deals cold damage. 

Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

bh2-24.name: Density
description: Black Hole lasts longer.

bh2-13.name: Pulsar
description: Black Hole will {Collapse} each second while it exists, but it deals less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

bh2-28.name: Singularity
description: Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but only 1 Black Hole can be created at a time.

bh2-20.name: Drifting Singularity
description: Black Hole moves toward the nearest enemy that is not within its damaging area.

bh2-27.name: Weakened Reality
description: Black Hole deals more damage to enemies within 1 meter of its center.
reminderText: This effect is multiplicative with other modifiers and does not affect ailments applied by Black Hole.

bh2-5.name: Scorching
description: Black Hole’s damage over time penetrates enemy fire resistance.

bh2-30.name: Pocket Dimension
description: You can store an additional charge of Black Hole.

bh2-7.name: Flaming
description: Black Hole deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

bh2-3.name: Absolute Zero
description: Black Hole has a chance to chill enemies within its area of effect each second.

bh2-6.name: Heat Wave
stats: +2% Ignite Chance Per Second Per 1% Uncapped Fire Res
description: Black Hole has a chance to ignite enemies within its area of effect each second based on your uncapped fire resistance.
reminderText: This scales off of uncapped fire resistance, so gaining more fire resistance above the normal 75% cap will continue to increase its effect. For example at 100% fire resistance, one point in this node grants 200% chance to ignite per second.

bh2-18.name: Intensity
description: Black Hole pulls enemies toward it faster and from within an increased area.

bh2-17.name: Recurrence
description: Black Hole's cooldown is reduced and it costs less mana, but pulls enemies towards it slower and pulls enemies within a lesser area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: Modifiers to the pull area do not affect the damage area.

bh2-16.name: Cascade Fracture
description: Black Hole has a chance to create another Black Hole once it expires.
reminderText: The second Black Hole cannot create another.

bh2-15.name: Time Dilation
description: Black Hole has increased duration and a chance to blind enemies within its area of effect each second.

bh2-11.name: Event Horizon
description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced cast speed.

bh2-29.name: Armageddon
description: Black Hole casts {Meteor} every second, but consumes Meteor's mana cost every second.
reminderText: Will only cast Meteor while above 0 mana.

su5g3-11.name: Static Buildup
description: Gain {Static Charges} when you use Surge.

su5g3-6.name: Shocking Blows
description: Surge deals additional melee lightning damage.

su5g3-8.name: Shielding Advance
description: You are invulnerable while Surging.

su5g3-9.name: Dynamics
description: Surge has increased duration, causing you to move slower.
reminderText: This does not affect the total distance travelled.

su5g3-4.name: Charged Movement
description: Surge has a chance to apply a {Spark Charge} on enemies.

su5g3-25.name: Insulation
description: Consuming stacks of {Dormant Energy} grants you ward per stack consumed.

su5g3-7.name: Lightning Rush
description: Surge deals more damage per 1% of movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

su5g3-19.name: Coldfront
description: Surge causes a {Tidal Wave} to continue past the arrival point, dealing spell cold damage and chills enemies.

su5g3-13.name: Discharge
description: You cast {Static} on arrival with Surge.

su5g3-0.name: Surge
description: Quick fixed distance dash which hits all enemies in the path with a lightning melee attack.

su5g3-12.name: Capacitator
description: You gain {Static Charges} on hit with Surge.

su5g3-18.name: Glacial Assault
description:
Surge's base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to shock now depend on Frostbite instead.

su5g3-28.name: Pyroclasm
description: Surge causes a {Flame Reave} to continue past the arrival point, a melee attack dealing fire damage in a cone in front of you. This effect costs Flame Reave's mana cost as well.

su5g3-20.name: Cryomantic Path

su5g3-26.name: Fulmination
description: You have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you consume a stack of {Dormant Energy}.

su5g3-14.name: Effluence

su5g3-17.name: Shielding Efflux
description: You gain ward on hit with Surge.

su5g3-15.name: Longstrider

su5g3-24.name: Storm Battery

ms26-16.name: Avatar of Hunger
description: Mana Strike leeches a percentage of damage dealt as health while you are not on full mana.

ms26-11.name: Repulsing Strikes

ms26-22.name: Shocking Force
description: Mana Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to shock enemies.

ms26-17.name: Mana Storm

ms26-23.name: Arcanist's Blade
description: Mana Strike's mana orbs restore additional mana.

ms26-3.name: Breaking Current
description: Mana Strike has a chance to shred armor and a chance to shock enemies.

ms26-9.name: Mana Drain
description: Mana Strike grants more mana gained (multiplicative with other modifiers) from its mana orbs and instant restoration.

ms26-28.name: Frigid Grasp

ms26-4.name: Rune Sap
stats: 4% Global Spell Damage Per Enemy Hit
description: Mana Strike hits grant you increased spell damage for 4 seconds. This effect can stack, and is doubled when hitting a boss or rare enemy.

ms26-7.name: Critical Mana

ms26-21.name: Reclamation

description: Mana Strike's mana orbs restore additional mana while you are out of mana.

ms26-10.name: Mana Cleave
description: Mana Strike now has a cooldown. It grants more mana gained from mana orbs and instant restoration, and it has more area of effect (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

ms26-20.name: Sprite Blade
description: Mana Strike has an increased area of effect.

ms26-24.name: Transfusion
stats: 25% Mana Gain -> Twice as Much Ward Gain
description: A portion of the mana gained from Mana Strike's mana orbs is instead gained as twice as much ward.

ms26-2.name: Swift Sap
description: Mana Strike has increased attack speed.

ms26-14.name: Mana Spark
stats: 5% Current Mana -> Added Melee Lightning Damage
description: Mana Strike has additional melee lightning damage equal to a percentage of your current mana.

ms26-26.name: Star Guide
description:
When you directly use Mana Strike and hit at least one enemy, you have a chance to cast {Static Orb}. This chance is doubled while you are above 80% mana. This effect can occur up to 3 times per 2 seconds, and consumes 120% of Static Orb's mana cost.

If Mana Strike has a cooldown, this effect is guaranteed.

ms26-8.name: Critical Rejuvenation
description: Mana Strike has significant additional critical strike chance, but Mana Strike's critical strikes no longer deal extra damage.
reminderText: Mana Strike will no longer receive critical strike multiplier from any source.

ms26-13.name: Celestial Precision
description: Mana Strike gains additional critical strike chance equal to a percentage of your current mana, but its base critical strike chance is removed.

ms26-25.name: Mind Warden

ms26-18.name: Explosive Flurry
description: Mana Strike has increased attack speed. {Mana Arc}'s mana consumption is reduced.

ms26-15.name: Starved Strikes
description: Mana Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you are not on full mana.

ms26-12.name: Spark Charges

ms26-19.name: Power Surge
description: Mana Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Mana Arc}'s mana consumption is increased.

ms26-5.name: Teleporting Strikes

ms26-6.name: Bountiful Victory
stats: 3 Mana Instantly Restored on Boss or Rare Hit
description: Mana Strike instantly restores mana when it kills an enemy, or when it hits a boss or rare enemy.

fb8fe-4.name: Ice Shard
description:
The {Fire Bolt's} base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to {Chill} for Runebolt and effects related to ignite now depend on chill instead.

Swaps the {Fire Bolt's} {Fire} tag for a {Cold} tag.

fb8fe-24.name: Arcane Restoration
description: Directly casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy has a chance to grant you mana.

fb8fe-13.name: Supercharged Bolt
description: Runebolt's chance to shoot extra projectiles from the {Arcane Overcharge} node and the amount of projectiles are doubled while standing in a {Glyph of Dominion}.
reminderText: Chance above 100% to shoot additional projectiles doesn't have any effect.

fb8fe-12.name: Arcane Overcharge
description: Runebolt has a chance to shoot additional projectiles in a volley in front of you.

fb8fe-32.name: Imbued Runestone
description:
If you have 3 {Runes} from {Runic Invocation} when you create a {Runestone}, the {Runes} are consumed to instead create an {Imbued Runestone} that fires three bolts. An {Imbued Runestone's} explosion has 100% more area of effect and damage.

Swaps the {Lightning Bolt's} {Lightning} tag for a {Cold} tag.

description: Runebolt deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

description:
Directly casting Runebolt now creates a {Runestone} in front of you if you do not currently have one nearby instead of casting a Runebolt. If you have a nearby {Runestone}, directly using Runebolt now casts two bolts from the {Runestone} towards the target.

reminderText: {Runestone} does not count as a minion.

fb8fe-14.name: Runic Evocation
description: Runebolt now shoots in a cone and the projectiles seek out enemies.

fb8fe-11.name: Efficient Experiment
stats: 1% Chance to Double Cast Per 5 Glyph of Chaos

Runebolt now randomly selects the element with each cast rather than by combo order. 

Directly casting Rune Bolt now has a chance to double cast if the previous cast was a different type. The chance is based on the amount of {Glyph of Chaos} you have in your crafting inventory.

fb8fe-28.name: Orderly Conduit
description:
Runebolt gains additional effects for each unique {Rune} you have. Multiple {Runes} of the same type does not stack the effect.

{Rah Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to ignite enemies.
{Gon Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to shock enemies.
{Heo Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to inflict {Frostbite} on enemies.

fb8fe-27.name: Cosmic Tapestry
stats: +1% Runic Invocation Crit Chance per stack
description: Each stack of {Runeweave} also grants your {Runic Invocation} additional critical strike chance.

fb8fe-21.name: Awakened Runestone
description: Every second while channeling a skill, your nearest {Runestone} has a chance to cast Runebolt towards your target.

fb8fe-25.name: Runeweaver
notScalingStats: 40% Mana Spent Gained As Ward per stack
description: Casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy grants you a stack of {Runeweave} up to a maximum.

fb8fe-17.name: Inscription of Momentum
description: When Runebolt passes through a {Frost Wall} it is intensified dealing more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and gains increased projectile speed.

fb8fe-16.name: Amplified Cascade

fb8fe-19.name: Kinetic Breach

gy2dm-7.name: Doom Scribe

gy2dm-3.name: Astral Extension

{Heo Rune}: Glyph inflicts stacks of Frostbite per second per {Rune} of this type.

gy2dm-16.name: Amplified Expanse

gy2dm-22.name: Power Word: Stun

gy2dm-24.name: Mage's Decree

gy2dm-17.name: Charged Reflections

gy2dm-4.name: Careful Drawings

gy2dm-5.name: Runecarver's Domain

gy2dm-19.name: Static Sparks

gy2dm-8.name: Runic Dominance

gy2dm-20.name: Sanctuary Threshold

gy2dm-18.name: Arcane Mirror
description: You and your allies gain additional resistances while standing on your {Glyph}.

fw3d-7.name: Frostguard
description: Flame Ward grants armor while active.

fw3d-18.name: Barrier
description: You take less damage from hits while Flame Ward is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fw3d-9.name: Rimeskin
description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

fw3d-33.name: Flame Runner
description: You have {Haste} while Flame Ward is active.

fw3d-20.name: Selfless Sorcery
description:
Flame Ward can be cast on allies.

fw3d-3.name: Retribution
description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fw3d-4.name: Telepyrosis
description: Flame Ward's retaliation is centered on the enemy that hits you, but it hits in a smaller area.

fw3d-6.name: Frost Ward
stats: 48 Fire Aura Freeze Rate Per Second
description:

fw3d-21.name: Shrewd Shielding
description: Flame Ward costs less mana.

fw3d-11.name: Dilation
description: Flame Ward costs less mana. Flame Ward and Fire Aura last longer.

fw3d-5.name: Blast Field
description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits in a larger area.

fw3d-22.name: Mental Aegis
description: Mana now absorbs damage while Flame Ward is active. Each point of mana shields 5 health and ward.

fw3d-17.name: Stalwart Defense
description: Flame Ward grants additional ward.

fw3d-12.name: Fire Aura
description: While active, Flame Ward grants you {Fire Aura}, a spell that deals fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.

fw3d-19.name: Prismatic Buffer
description: Flame Ward reduces elemental damage taken while active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fw3d-28.name: Desperate Defense

fw3d-30.name: Dual Aegis

fw3d-14.name: Energize

fw3d-2.name: Infusion
description:
Flame Ward grants increased fire damage while active

fw3d-29.name: Fuel The Flames

fw3d-13.name: Eye of Flame
description: {Fire Aura} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This also effects Fire Aura from sources other than Flame Ward.

fw3d-8.name: Glacial Reinforcement
description: Flame Ward grants additional block chance, block effectiveness, and ward on block while active.

fw3d-23.name: Warmth
description: Flame Ward grants increased mana regeneration while active.

fw3d-27.name: Fortification
description: Flame Ward grants significantly more ward, but no longer retaliates.

fw3d-34.name: Warden Pulse
description: Enemies around you are knocked back when you use Flame Ward

fw3d-16.name: Through Flames
description:
Flame Ward grants additional fire damage to attacks and spells while active.

If Flame Ward is converted to cold or lightning, then this added damage is also converted.

fw3d-25.name: Concentrated Shielding
description: Flame Ward grants additional ward, but has a shorter duration.

fw3d-31.name: Astonish
description: Flame Ward is cast when you are stunned, if it is off cooldown and you have positive mana.

fw3d-24.name: Recollection
description: Flame Ward grants increased ward retention while active.

frc87w-17.name: Reowyn's Veil
description: When you cast Frost Claw you gain ward based on its Freeze Rate Multiplier.
reminderText: Addtional Freeze Rate Multiplier from this tree, including from Cold and Calculating, is taken into account for this node.

frc87w-13.name: Kolheim Ballista
stats: +4% Ice Barrage Rate of Fire on Hit
description: If you have an active {Ice Barrage} when you hit an enemy with Frost Claw, that Ice Barrage fires faster for the rest of its duration, up to a maximum.
reminderText: This fire rate modifier is multiplicative with other modifiers.

frc87w-26.name: Frozen Malice
description:
The second cast from {On Through The Snow} targets a random enemy that is 3 to 9 meters away from the original target location.

frc87w-24.name: On Through The Snow

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

frc87w-8.name: Brightfrost
description: You have increased cast speed with Frost Claw.

frc87w-3.name: Cold Star
description: Frost Claw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its explosion deals damage in a larger area. These bonuses are doubled if you have at least 1200 ward.

frc87w-29.name: Volley of Glass
description:
Frost Claw no longer creates a burst of damage at the target, but its projectiles are now staggered and they can all hit the same target.

Frost Claw's mana cost is increased, it no longer has the {Area} tag and it has a lowered base freeze rate.

frc87w-16.name: Shiver Shell
description:
When you are hit by an enemy you have a chance to retaliate with Frost Claw.

When you cast Frost Claw by any method you gain Ward.

frc87w-30.name: Frozen Reign

fl71ds-24.name: Ember Wake
stats: Fire Rune Embers While Not In Flame Rush
description: Every 0.4 seconds during Flame Rush you create a {Rune Ember}, up to a maximum. Every 0.25 seconds while not in Flame Rush you fire a {Rune Ember} at a nearby enemy if you have any.

fl71ds-15.name: Epilogue
description:
You cast {Runic Invocation} when you exit Flame Rush, if you have it on your action bar.

This effect consumes mana equal to a percentage of {Runic Invocation's} mana cost.

fl71ds-18.name: Smolder and Burn
stats: +1 Fire Shred Stacks On Pass Through
description: Flame Rush now applies {Fire Resistance Shred} on enemies it passes through.
reminderText: This effect does not apply to the explosion.

ib5g3-3.name: Subthermal Velocity
description:
When a target is frozen by Ice Barrage, you are granted increased cast speed for 4 seconds.

This effect can stack a limited number of times.

ib5g3-17.name: Challenge the Elements
stats: 10% Increased Fire Rate Against Rare Enemies
description: Ice Barrage hits against bosses and rare enemies grant increased fire rate to the remaining hits. This effect stacks up to a cap.
reminderText: This bonus is additive with other sources of Increased Rate of Fire on this tree.

ib5g3-9.name: Ice Spire
description: Ice Barrage has a faster rate of fire, but you move more slowly while it is active.

ib5g3-8.name: Cryogenesis
description: Ice Barrage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a shorter duration.

ib5g3-22.name: Nailed Shot
description: Each ice shard cast by Ice Barrage has a chance to pierce all enemies (continue through enemies hit).

ib5g3-28.name: Frozen Ballista
description: Ice Barrage deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown, but now only lasts 1 second and fires 3 projectiles.
reminderText: This node does not prevent additional projectiles created with Wintry Blast or Ice Burst.

ib5g3-32.name: Arctic Storm
description: Ice shards released via {Ice Burst} have a higher chance to freeze enemies, and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ib5g3-14.name: Looming Frost
description:
Each ice shard released by Ice Barrage deals more damage than the previous shard (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This bonus stacks, but is reset on recasting Ice Barrage.

ib5g3-19.name: Brightlance
description: Ice Barrage hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer seek nearby enemies.

ib5g3-7.name: Warding Bolts
description: You have a chance to gain ward on hit with Ice Barrage.

ib5g3-30.name: Shattered Skin
stats: 15% More Hit Damage To Frozen Targets
description: Ice Barrage hits deal more damage to frozen targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ib5g3-4.name: Intensifying Cold
stats: +10% Freeze Rate Multiplier Per Ice Shard
description:
Each ice shard released by Ice Barrage has a higher chance of freezing enemies than the previous shard.

This effect resets when Ice Barrage is recast.

ib5g3-29.name: Jagged Ice
stats: 20% More Crit Chance Against Frozen Targets
description: Ice Barrage has more critical strike chance against frozen targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ib5g3-6.name: Hail Storm
description: Ice Barrage has a faster rate of fire.

ib5g3-23.name: Hypothermia
description: Ice Shards that pierce enemies have a chance to inflict them with {Frostbite}.

ib5g3-15.name: Sleetfire
description: Ice Barrage has significantly increased fire rate, but while it is active all skills have increased mana cost.

ib5g3-16.name: Eternal Winter
description: Ice Barrage lasts longer.

ib5g3-2.name: Frigid Barrage
description: Ice Barrage hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

ib5g3-27.name: Brittle Fragments
description: Ice Shards cast by Ice Barrage shatter and deal cold damage in a cone behind the target. This does not work on piercing projectiles.

ib5g3-10.name: Ice Shield
description:
When you cast Ice Barrage you now also summon an {Ice Shield} in the target direction, a shield that blocks projectiles. Ice Shield lasts 2 seconds.

Ice Barrage has a longer cooldown.

ib5g3-21.name: Biting Cold
description: Ice Barrage deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has more critical strike chance.

ib5g3-5.name: Frigid Doom
description: When Ice Barrage hits an enemy it has a chance to cast {Frost Nova}, a cold spell that damages nearby enemies.

ib5g3-24.name: Sublimation
description:
Ice Barrage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its ice shards become larger.

Ice Barrage has a slower fire rate, and there is a longer delay between each shard being created and released.
reminderText:
The fire rate modifier is multiplicative with other fire rate modifiers on this tree.

The change to the delay does not affect the frequence at which shards are created.

ib5g3-12.name: Deep Shield
description: {Ice Shield} lasts longer, but Ice Barrage has a longer cooldown.

ib5g3-0.name: Ice Barrage
description: Repeatedly casts Ice Shards in a target direction.

ib5g3-13.name: Frost Armor
description: While {Ice Shield} is active, you deal more global cold damage and take less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

ib5g3-11.name: Shattering Bulwark
description: When {Ice Shield} expires it explodes, freezing nearby enemies.

ib5g3-25.name: Wintry Blast
description: Ice Barrage now fires 5 ice shards in a cone in front of you, but has a slower fire rate and costs more mana.
reminderText: The fire rate modifier is multiplicative with other fire rate modifiers on this tree.

ib5g3-26.name: Yrun's Conquest
description: Ice Barrage releases ice shards in a wider cone.

ib5g3-20.name: Aura of Frost
description: Ice Barrage creates a {Chilling Aura} around you. The aura repeatedly applies chill to nearby enemies for a duration. This effect can apply multiple stacks of chill to the same enemy.

ib5g3-31.name: Ice Burst
description: Ice Barrage instantly fires 5 ice shards in a cone.

te44-18.name: Wormhole
description: Your other skills recover more quickly if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).
reminderText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds

te44-10.name: Uncontrolled Duplication
description: Teleport creates additional {Mirror Images} on arrival. Mirror images have a shorter duration.
reminderText: {Mirror Image} health scales with intelligence and level.

te44-15.name: Resonant Plasma
description: You have higher lightning resistance, fire resistance, and stun avoidance if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

te44-22.name: Elemental Midnight
description:
Teleport casts Elemental Nova halfway between your arrival and departure points.

This node does not work if Elemental Nova has a cooldown.

te44-9.name: Unexpected Copy
description: Teleport creates a {Mirror Image} where you arrive. Mirror Images count as minions and will taunt nearby enemies for 10 seconds, then disappear. Teleport costs more mana.
reminderText: {Mirror Image} health scales with intelligence and level.

te44-17.name: Flicker
description: Teleport costs less mana.

te44-8.name: Decoy Position
description: Teleport creates a {Mirror Image} where you depart. Mirror Images count as minions and will taunt nearby enemies for 10 seconds, then disappear. Teleport costs more mana.
reminderText: {Mirror Image} health scales with intelligence and level.

te44-26.name: Comet Rush
description: Teleport has a shorter cooldown and if you have {Haste} when you cast Teleport its duration is reset.
reminderText: This cannot reduce the duration of Haste on you, only increase it or leave it unchanged.

te44-11.name: Stable Duplicants
description: {Mirror Images} last longer.
reminderText: {Mirror Image} health scales with intelligence and level.

te44-24.name: Rock Phase
description: You cannot be stunned if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

te44-5.name: Tunnel Finder
description: Teleport has a shorter cooldown.

te44-4.name: Mana Tunnel
description: After casting Teleport your next direct spell cast refunds its mana cost, but Teleport has a longer cooldown.

te44-20.name: Elemental Dawn
description:
Teleport casts Elemental Nova where you arrive.

This node does not work if Elemental Nova has a cooldown.

te44-14.name: Stable Bubble
description: You have increased ward retention if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).
reminderText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds

te44-3.name: Frigid Departure
description: You have a higher chance to freeze enemies if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

te44-2.name: Unstable Arrival
description: Teleport knocks enemies back from your destination once you arrive.

te44-7.name: Time Dilation
description: Stat buffs granted by having cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds) last longer.

te44-19.name: Elemental Affinity
description: You deal increased elemental damage if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).
reminderText: Recently refers to the past 4 seconds

te44-23.name: Out of Body
description: Casting Teleport converts a percentage of your current health into twice as much ward.
reminderText: For example if you have three points in this node, and 100 current health, you will lose 9 health and gain 18 ward.

te44-16.name: Intense Arrival
description: Teleport knocks enemies further back.

te44-12.name: Ether Barrier
description: Teleport grants ward on cast.

te44-21.name: Elemental Dusk
description:
Teleport casts Elemental Nova where you depart.

This node does not work if Elemental Nova has a cooldown.

te44-6.name: Crystaline Passage
description: You have higher cold resistance and armor if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

te44-13.name: Out of Mind
stats: 1 Ward Gained Per Point Of Intelligence
description: When you use Teleport, you are granted ward equal to your intelligence stat.

Mage-4.name: Preparation
description: Every 3 seconds, your next elemental spell deals increased damage and has a chance to slow enemies on hit.

Mage-58.name: Arcane Wind
description: When you hit an enemy with a cold skill you {Chill} additional nearby enemies. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.
reminderText: This effect can chill the initial enemy you hit unless it was killed by that hit.

Mage-0.name: Arcanist
reminderText: Each point of intelligence grants 4% ward retention and improves skills that rely on carefully studied magic, such as Lightning Blast and Mana Strike.

Mage-45.name: Sun and Storms
description:
You deal increased fire and lightning damage.

You gain ward when you use a lightning skill or a fire skill. This effect has a 7 second cooldown, but the cooldown is not shared between different elements, so you can gain ward from a fire skill and a lightning skill within the same 7 second duration.
reminderText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

Mage-6.name: Arcane Current
description: When you hit an enemy with a lightning skill you cast {Lightning Blast} at other enemies within 6 meters of your target. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.
reminderText: This effect cannot choose the same enemy more than once from a single trigger.

Mage-24.name: Rune of Winter
description:
Increases your chance to freeze and converts lightning blast and volcanic orb to cold spells, changing their base damage type to cold and giving them a chance to freeze.

Lightning Blast gains a base freeze rate of 46.

Volcanic Orb's core gains a base freeze rate of 40 and its shrapnel gains a freeze rate of 32.

Mage-8.name: Warden
reminderText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time. Ward retention slows that decay.

Mage-3.name: Reactive Ward
description: When you drop below 70% health you gain a burst of ward based on your maximum health. This effect has a 12 second cooldown.
reminderText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

Mage-5.name: Mage Flurry
notScalingStats: 9% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Teleport
9% Increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for Snap Freeze

Mage-78.name: Silver Rune
description: Augments the ward gain effects of the {Reactive Ward} and {Sun and Storms} nodes, causing them to grant more ward and have shorter cooldowns.
reminderText: Ward is a shield that protects your health. It has no maximum and decays over time.

Mage-7.name: Arcane Flames
description: When you hit an enemy with a fire skill you {Ignite} additional nearby enemies. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.
reminderText: This effect can ignite the initial enemy you hit unless it was killed by that hit.

Mage-2.name: Elementalist
description: Increases your elemental damage
reminderText: Fire, cold, and lightning damage are all considered elemental damage.

me27-23.name: World Ender
description: Meteor always crits if you have more than 400 mana before you cast it.

me27-2.name: Infernal Descent
description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Meteor has reduced cast speed.

me27-17.name: Mana Fall
description: Meteor costs less mana.

me27-6.name: Jagged Fragments
description: {Shrapnel} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: {Shrapnel} scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage, but not with other nodes on this tree unless stated otherwise.

me27-7.name: Rapid Break Up
description: {Shrapnel} travels faster, causing it to travel further.
reminderText: {Shrapnel} scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage, but not with other nodes on this tree unless stated otherwise.

me27-19.name: Extinction
description: Improves Meteor's base critical strike chance. Meteor has a chance to deal damage in a significantly increased area.

me27-16.name: Infernal Column
description: Meteors fall in a line towards where you aim, but Meteor costs more mana.

me27-15.name: Rapid Impacts
description: Meteors fall more frequently. This does not affect the total number of Meteors that fall.

me27-3.name: Celestial Celerity
description: Meteor has increased cast speed, but costs more mana. Meteors fall faster.

me27-14.name: Meteor Shower
stats: +1 Number Of Meteors For Direct Casts
description: When directly cast, more Meteors fall per cast, but individual Meteors deal damage in a smaller area.

me27-0.name: Meteor
reminderText: Added damage is applied at 1200% effectiveness

me27-13.name: Distant Craters
description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but meteors fall further apart.

me27-8.name: Piercing Remnants
description: {Shrapnel} projectiles pierce (continue through targets they hit), but travel slower.
reminderText: {Shrapnel} scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage, but not with other nodes on this tree unless stated otherwise.

me27-11.name: Rapid Descent
description: Meteor falls faster.

me27-25.name: Craterborn
description: Casting Meteor grants the {Craterborn} buff, granting additional fire penetration and increased cast speed for a short duration. Craterborn does not stack.

me27-5.name: Shattering Star
description: Meteor has a chance to break into {Shrapnel} on impact, hitting nearby enemies.
reminderText: {Shrapnel} scales with increases to spell damage and fire damage, but not with other nodes on this tree unless stated otherwise.

me27-20.name: Astral Cataclysm
description: Meteor critical strikes deal more damage.

me27-26.name: Cycle of Fire
description: Directly casting Fireball while you have {Craterborn} grants ward and restores your mana.

me27-12.name: Twin Meteors
stats: +1 Number Of Meteors For Direct Casts
description: When directly cast, an additional Meteor falls within a 4m radius of the first, but Meteor costs much more mana.
reminderText: Increased Area for Area Skills stats still only affect the area of effect of each individual meteor, not the size of the area in which they drop.

me27-9.name: Force of Impact
description: Meteor has a chance to stun enemies and stuns it inflict last longer.

me27-4.name: Crushing Force
description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and even more against enemies at full health.

me27-10.name: Stardust
description: Meteors deal more damage of all types except fire (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: Meteor deals only fire damage by default, so for this node to have an any effect you must first add non-fire damage from another source, such as an item.

me27-27.name: Heat Flux
description: Meteors cast {Frost Claw} towards a nearby enemy on impact, consuming 120% of Frost Claw's mana cost.

me27-22.name: Rain of Fire
stats: +1 Number Of Meteors For Direct Casts
description: When directly cast, more Meteors fall per cast.

me27-18.name: Apocalyptic Impact
description: Meteors deals damage in a larger area of effect.

me27-24.name: Aftermath
description:
After you cast Meteor you recover a portion of the mana spent over the next three seconds. 

You can only recover mana from one cast at once, so if you cast meteor again within three seconds you lose the remaining mana you would have recovered from the first cast.

dig5-13.name: Laser Focus
description: Disintegrate no longer costs mana while channeling, but it also deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dig5-4.name: Catalyst
description: Flame Energy builds up more quickly.

dig5-17.name: Escalation
description: Disintegrate is upgraded to tier 2 after 2 seconds of channeling. Tier 2 Disintegrate deals more damage, but costs more mana to channel.

dig5-6.name: Praesidium
stats: +1 Ward Gained Per 3 Int Per Second
description: You gain ward each second based on your Intelligence while channeling Disintegrate.

dig5-22.name: Magnify
stats: 60% Ignite Chance On Hit -> Ignite Chance Per Second
description: Disintegrate gains a portion of your chance to ignite with fire spells on hit as ignite chance per second.

dig5-23.name: Infernal Ray
description:
Disintegrate’s base lightning damage is converted to fire damage, unless you have the {Electrify} node.

Disintegrate loses the {lightning} tag.

dig5-14.name: Hyperfocal
description: Disintegrate deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your maximum mana.

dig5-32.name: Backfire
description: Flame energy builds up on enemies within the beam, causing an explosion that deals fire damage around them after 3 seconds of taking damage.
reminderText: 3 seconds if the target stays in the beam.

dig5-37.name: Flame Vent
description:
When you stop channeling Disintegrate, you cast {Fireball} at nearby enemies twice per second spent channeling, up to a maximum.

This consumes mana equal to {Fireball's} mana cost.

dig5-8.name: Twinbeam
description:
Disintegrate now has two beams, and each beam deals damage independently, so enemies caught in both take double damage.

Disintegrate costs more mana per second to channel, and each beam deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dig5-15.name: Paralyze
description: Shock inflicted by Disintegrate lasts longer and Disintegrate deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Shock on the target.
reminderText: Direct damage modifiers do not affect damage of ailments or subskills.

dig5-35.name: Charge Conduit
description: You gain {Static Charges} each second while channeling Disintegrate.

dig5-24.name: Inferno
description: You have a chance each second to cast {Fire Aura} while channeling Disintegrate.

dig5-16.name: Tendrils
description:
You have a chance each second to cast {Lightning Blast} at a nearby enemy.

This consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

dig5-20.name: Intensify
description: Disintegrate upgrades to the next Tier faster. This also affects the rate at which you gain stacks of {Lucomancer}.

dig5-28.name: Galvanized Defense
description: You take less damage while channeling Disintegrate (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dig5-18.name: Amplification
description: Disintegrate is upgraded to tier 3 after 4 seconds of channeling. Tier 3 grants double the bonuses of tier 2.

dig5-21.name: Glass Cannon
description: Disintegrate deals more damage while at Tier 2, but also causes you to take more damage while at tier 2 (both multiplicative with other modifiers and each other), and these effects are are doubled at Tier 3.

dig5-36.name: Resurgence
stats: Starts At Tier 3 With 2 Stacks Of Lucomancer
description:
If you start channeling Disintegrate while having at least 1 stack of {Lucomancer} it starts at Tier 2.

If you also have the {Amplification} node and at least 2 stacks of {Lucomancer}, Disintegrate starts at Tier 3 instead.

dig5-26.name: Lucomancer
stats: +4% Global Damage to Ignited or Shocked Enemies
description:
For every 2 seconds you spend channeling Disintegrate, you gain a stack of {Lucomancer}, up to 2 stacks and each stack lasts 4 seconds. Stacks are refreshed when you gain a new one.

Lucomancer grants global more damage to ignited or shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and global reduced mana cost.

dig5-19.name: Unbridled Power
description:
While your Disintegrate is at tier 3 you have a chance to inflict {Spreading Flames} and {Spark Charges} on enemies in the beam each second while channeling.

If Disintegrate is converted to {fire}, the {Spark Charges} are converted to {Spreading Flames}.

If Disintegrate is converted to {lightning}, the {Spreading Flames} is converted to {Spark Charges}.

dig5-5.name: Searing Plasma
description: Disintegrate deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

dig5-7.name: Cascade
description: Your skills recover their cooldowns faster while you are channeling Disintegrate.

dig5-25.name: Extension
description: Disintegrate has a longer range.

dig5-12.name: Electrify
description:
Disintegrate’s base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Disintegrate loses the {fire} tag.

dig5-30.name: Dragon Tongue
description: Disintegrate deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your Intelligence.

dig5-10.name: Stored Power
description: Disintegrate deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a delay before casting. This delay is reduced by increased cast speed.

dig5-2.name: Temporal Entrapment
description: Disintegrate has a chance to slow enemies caught within the beam.

dig5-11.name: Feedback
description: Disintegrate has a chance to shock enemies caught within the beam.

dig5-34.name: Unleashed Power
description:
Every 3 seconds of channelling Disintegrate, you cast {Static Orb} or {Volcanic Orb}, chosen randomly.

If Disintegrate is converted to {fire}, you always cast {Volcanic Orb}.

If Disintegrate is converted to {lightning}, you always cast {Static Orb}.

This consumes mana equal to the mana cost of those respective abilities.

fi9-10.name: Igneous Force
description: Nodes on this tree that add crit chance instead increase stun chance by 20 times the stated value.

fi9-16.name: Burning Wounds
stats: 25% More Crit Chance Against Ignited Enemies
description: Fireball hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fi9-21.name: Volatile flames
description: Flame Burst requires fewer hits with Fireball to trigger.
reminderText: {Flame Burst} is a fire spell that deals high damage in an area.

fi9-19.name: Seeker's Ash
description: Fireballs now seek nearby targets.

fi9-24.name: Flamethrower
description: Fireball becomes a channeled ability that rapidly spews fireballs from your hand, but rapidly drains your mana.
reminderText:
Increased cast speed affects how quickly you start channeling, but does not affect the number of fireballs per second.
Channeled skills have a minimum mana cost of 1.

fi9-7.name: Fire Spray
description: Fireball releases additional projectiles that fire in a cone when cast, but costs more mana.
reminderText: Projectiles are fired all at once in a cone

fi9-12.name: Dancing Fire
description: Fireball releases additional projectiles. These additional projectiles are NOT reduced by the extra projectiles penalty via the {Embers} node.
reminderText: Not affected by Embers' penalty to the number of extra projectiles

fi9-2.name: Piercing Heat
description: Fireball now pierces enemies (continue through targets it hits), but costs more mana.

fi9-23.name: Unchained Fire
description: Fireball has increased cast speed and deals more damage for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer fires extra projectiles.

fi9-17.name: Adept
description: Fireball has increased cast speed.

fi9-14.name: Spreading Inferno
description:
Fireball hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}, an ailment which deals fire damage over time and spreads to nearby enemies.

Additionally all damage over time ailments applied by Fireball deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifier).

fi9-9.name: Arcane Divergence
description: Fireball releases additional projectiles that fire in a cone when cast, but costs more mana.

fi9-11.name: Embers
stats: Projectiles Can Hit The Same Target
description: Directly cast Fireballs fire in sequence in the same direction and can now hit the same target, but Fireball releases fewer projectiles and has less cast speed for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers).
reminderText: This node enables the extra projectiles to hit the same enemy

fi9-25.name: Forbidden Flames
description: Fireballs have a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets it hits), but {Flamethrower} costs more mana per second to channel.

fi9-5.name: Plasma Ball
description:
Half of Fireball's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this portion of its damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fireball gains a {Lightning} tag.

Fireball also gains additional critical strike multiplier.

fi9-13.name: Conflagration
description: Fireball hits have a higher chance to ignite enemies.

fi9-4.name: Orb of Destruction
description: Improves Fireball's base critical strike chance.

fi9-28.name: Infernal Legacy
description: Fireballs last longer, causing them to travel further.

fi9-20.name: Flame Burst
description: Hitting the same enemy with several fireballs triggers a {Flame Burst} around them.
reminderText: {Flame Burst} is a fire spell that deals high damage in an area.

fi9-6.name: Winged Fire
description: Fireball deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and travels faster, causing it to travel farther.

fi9-27.name: Magma Shell
description: You have additional Armor and Fire Resistance while channeling Fireball's {Flamethrower}.

fi9-22.name: Mana Sphere
description: Fireball deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

fi9-15.name: Wildfire
description: {Spreading Flames} applied by fireball has additional fire penetration

fi9-8.name: Skira's Gambit
description: Fireball has additional critical strike chance, but it has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fi9-26.name: Eternal Fire
description: {Flamethrower} costs less mana per second to channel.
reminderText: This is additive with the channel cost modifier from the {Ghostfire} node.

fi9-3.name: Immolated Core
description: Fireball hits have additional fire penetration and lightning penetration.

fi9-18.name: Flammability
description: Fireball hits have a chance to reduce enemy fire resistance.
reminderText: This effect grants an equal amount of lightning resistance shred chance if Fireball has been converted to lightning.

vm53dx-27.name: Revelation
description: The burst of ward and mana after channelling for exactly one second grants additional ward and mana.

vm53dx-2.name: Resolute Stance
description: Focus grants increased health regeneration while channeled.

vm53dx-8.name: Shocking Aura
description: Focus grants a chance to shock nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

vm53dx-11.name: Iron Stance
description: Focus heightens your armor while channeling (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants you additional armor based on your intelligence.

vm53dx-19.name: Everward
description: Focus grants additional ward retention while channeled.

vm53dx-24.name: Rapid Overflow
description: {Energy Overflow} is cast more frequently.

vm53dx-4.name: Null Profusion
description: Casting Focus while at negative mana instantly grants mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

vm53dx-9.name: Nerve Center
description: Shocks, chills and ignites inflicted by Focus have a longer duration.

vm53dx-10.name: Burning Aura
description: Focus grants a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

vm53dx-17.name: Prism Barrier
description: Focus grants additional resistance while channeled.

vm53dx-25.name: Unstable Energy
description: The waves of lightning released by the Energy Overflow and Energy Battery nodes deal more damage while you are at full mana (multiplicative with other modifiers).

vm53dx-6.name: Calm Mind
stats: Instant Mana Gain Also Applies To Ward
description: The mana gained from the Null Profusion and Null Infusion nodes is also gained as ward, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

vm53dx-22.name: Mind's Shield
description: You gain ward equal to a percentage of the mana you gained once you finish channeling.

vm53dx-16.name: Overcharge
description: Focus can increase your current mana to a percentage above your maximum mana. The excess decays at a rate of 10 mana per second after you stop channeling.

vm53dx-18.name: Friendly Focus
description: Focus can be cast on allies.
reminderText: All effects granted by Focus are applied to the ally instead unless they specify "you".

vm53dx-28.name: Unbound Thought
description:
Focus no longer has a cooldown, but the burst no longer grants mana.

This node has no effect if you have either the {Null Profusion} node or the {Conveyance} node.

vm53dx-14.name: Inner Growth
description: Focus heals the target each second while channeled.
reminderText: This effect is affected by increased healing effectiveness.

vm53dx-20.name: Energy Battery
description: When you finish channeling, you unleash a wave of lightning with base damage equal to a percentage of the mana you gained while channeling.
reminderText: The lightning wave counts as a spell, and its damage scales with Intelligence.

vm53dx-12.name: Chilling Aura
description: Focus grants a chance to chill nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

vm53dx-13.name: Prismatic Stance
description: Focus grants less elemental damage taken while channeled (multiplicative with other modifiers).

vm53dx-26.name: Mind Shell
description: Focus grants additional ward per second while channeled.

vm53dx-23.name: Energy Overflow
description: You unleash waves of lightning with base damage equal to a percentage of your maximum mana to nearby enemies each second while channeling.
reminderText: If cast on an ally, the waves of lightning will occur at their location.

vm53dx-15.name: Mind's Eye
description: Focus has increased healing effectiveness per point of intelligence.

vm53dx-7.name: Mana Flooded
description: Focus grants increased mana regeneration while channeled.

vm53dx-3.name: Desperate Meditation
stats: 1% Increased Mana Regen Per Missing Mana
description: Focus grants increased mana regeneration while channeled proportional to the amount of mana you are missing when you start channeling.
reminderText: Each point of negative mana counts as missing an addional point of mana. For example, with 1 point invested, if you have 10 maximum mana and are at -10 mana then this node will increase mana regen by 20%.

vm53dx-30.name: Conveyance
stats: Does not use the Teleport Skill or Tree
description:
You teleport to the target location when you start channelling Focus, as long as the location is accessible. This does not count as casting the Teleport skill and is not affected by Teleport's skill tree.

Focus now counts as a {Traversal} skill.
reminderText: Using a Traversal skill puts all other traversal skills on cooldown and traversal skills' cooldowns do not recover while you are using a traversal skill.

vm53dx-5.name: Null Infusion
description: Casting Focus while at negative mana instantly grants mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

vm53dx-21.name: Energy Infusion
description: You gain Haste for 1 second per 20 mana you gained while channeling once you finish channeling. Maximum of 10 seconds.

fr4wl-13.name: Prepared Wards
stats: Flame Ward On Ally Pass Through
description:
You now cast Flame Ward on you or your allies (excluding their minions) that pass through your Frost Wall, if it has existed for at least 0.2 seconds.

Frost Wall now has a cooldown, which it shares with Flame Ward. Using one will put the other on cooldown.

fr4wl-8.name: Crystals of Protection
description:
Frost Wall now grants you and your allies ward and mana when they first pass through the wall.

These effects are doubled if the wall is placed at least 2 meters away from you.

fr4wl-22.name: Shelter of the Chef
description: Whenever an enemy passes through the wall for the first time, and after it has existed for 0.2 seconds, you gain ward equal to a small portion of the enemy's maximum health, up to a maximum amount of ward per enemy.

fr4wl-11.name: Shattered to Pieces
description: The {Runic Detonations} from {Runic Conclusion} intensify, destroying the wall in the process and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

fr4wl-16.name: Chilled Touch
description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to chilled enemies while you have an active Frost Wall.

fr4wl-19.name: Frigid Domination
stats: +1 Spell Damage Per 20% Freeze Rate Multiplier
description: Frost Wall deals additional spell damage equal to a portion of your freeze rate multiplier.

fr4wl-14.name: Heaping Cold
description: If you haven't cast Frost Wall in the past 15 seconds, it has no mana cost and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

fr4wl-15.name: Marching Winter
description: Frost Wall is larger and lasts longer.

fr4wl-17.name: The Dark Cold
stats: +3% Damage Over Time Per Second Of Existence
description:
Frost Wall deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second the wall has existed.

This does not affect ailments or subskills.

fr4wl-2.name: Lightning Rod
description:
One of Frost Wall's {Pillars} now casts {Lightning Blast} at nearby enemies when you first pass through the wall.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.
reminderText: This requires you to be at positive mana when cast.

fr4wl-4.name: Amplified Currents
description: After Frost Wall has existed for a short duration, its outer {Pillars} cast {Lightning Blast} more often, up to a maximum, every time an enemy passes through the wall.

fr4wl-23.name: Pyroglass
description:
{Frost Wall's} base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

For Frost Wall, chill chance from all sources is converted to {Ignite}, and Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to {Fire Resistance Shred}.

Swaps {Frost Wall's} {Cold} tag for a {Fire} tag.

fr4wl-6.name: Purifying Gate
stats: Cleanses Negative Ailments On Pass Through
description: Frost Wall now cleanses negative ailments on you and your allies when they first pass through the wall.

fr4wl-18.name: Howling Rift
description: When you cast Frost Wall while having an existing wall active with more than half its duration remaining, the existing wall is moved to the new target location instead of being replaced and you gain mana equal to half the Frost Wall’s mana cost.
reminderText: This allows it to hit the same enemies or allies an additional time.

fr4wl-10.name: Runic Conclusion
description: Frost Wall now creates three {Runic Detonations} shortly after you pass through it, dealing spell cold damage to nearby enemies.
reminderText:
This effect doesn't destroy the wall.

{Runic Detonations} can be converted to fire with the {Pyroglass} node and to lightning with the {Crackling Barrier} node.

An enemy can be hit by multiple detonations at once.

fr4wl-20.name: Frozen Throne
description:
Frost Wall's initial freeze has increased duration, and the wall deals more damage over time to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This does not affect ailments or subskills.

fr4wl-28.name: Arcane Mosaic
description: Frost Wall casts {Runebolt} more often.

fr4wl-12.name: Glyph of Direfrost
description: The {Runic Detonations} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area if you are facing away from the wall when the detonations occur.

fr4wl-5.name: Aspirant's Arrival
description:
After you pass through your Frost Wall your next {Runic Invocation} or {Glyph of Dominion} cast within 5 seconds is empowered. 

An empowered spell cast this way, costs less mana (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second the wall has existed, before you walk through it.

fr4wl-26.name: Crackling Barrier
description:
{Frost Wall's} base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

For Frost Wall, chill chance from all sources is converted to {Slow}, and Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to {Shock}.

Swaps Frost Wall's {Cold} tag for a {Lightning} tag.
reminderText: This node has no effect if Frost Wall is converted to Fire.

fr4wl-21.name: Protection of the Apostate
stats: 5 Ward Gain On Enemy Pass Through
